information: ![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png) Please note, this competition includes only blindfolded events, clock and FMC. If you are interested in non-blindfolded events we recommend signing up to the [Speedcubing Australia mailing list](https://speedcubing.org.au/subscribe/) to be notified as new competitions are announced. Competitors are strongly encouraged to bring a guest who is familiar with the process of judging blindfolded solving. This will be allocated on a first-come-first serve basis in order of payment. **Contact us** We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)! [Speedcubing Australia Website](https://speedcubing.org.au)
